notes.title: Final Release Date Confirmed - Livber Story Collection - 3: The Porph Hunt!
notes.notes:
Final Release Date Confirmed
Greetings from the dark streets of Livber,

We were originally planning to release the game on September 30, but we didn’t want to give you a version filled with bugs and missing features. The good news: Our launch is now locked for October 28 during Steam Scream Fest.


Thank you so much for your patience and support.


Now for the fun part, our third mini-story is ready!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609737/cde078591c64b7efda01c57d8ff8becd16c4e268.png"]

This month’s story is ready. In the third entry of our mini-story series, we’re diving into the interesting world of the Porph animals! Join the hunters as they track these strange animals in a dangerous game of wits and survival.



As always, this story is sent exclusively to our mailing list subscribers. It arrives as a high-resolution PDF and is completely free.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609737/567ceba5e6dad384379adc9ba2938bf1c95a2824.png"]



There will be a total of 10 stories in this collection. When the game is released, all of them will be included in our digital Art Book DLC. But until then, subscribers can receive them early and for free.

If you’d like to join, you can sign up at the end of the demo or homepage of our new site:

https://www.inevgames.com/



Thank you for your support. Even just sharing the game or mentioning it to a friend helps us a lot.

notes.title: Another Big Update - A New Demo and a New Trailer
notes.notes:
Greetings from the dark streets of Livber
Demo v3 is now live on Steam, bringing even more polish and shadows to your journey. Here’s what’s new:



[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45609737/1c71a16cfa7588e8ce1c7216a6f5f59256d5b0d3.jpg"]
Parallax Animation Fix

-Cinematic depth is back on track, with smoother, more stable scene transitions.

Enhanced Visuals

-Refined artwork and details breathe even more life (and dread) into every frame.

Sound Mixer Added

-Fine-tune your experience with full control over the game’s haunting audio.

UI Improvements

-Menus and interfaces reworked for clarity without losing their eerie touch.

Starred Image Tooltips

-Easily spot important visuals with our new tooltip star system.

Story Additions

-Fresh narrative layers woven into the tale for you to uncover.

Bug Fixes

-A cleaner, more reliable path through Livber’s dark streets.
[hr][/hr]

New Animated Trailer
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45609737/ecb24ece866a4675a0b4ed884ace8893b6959fab.png"]

Watch YouTube Video

We’ve just released an all-new animated trailer that captures the heart of Livber’s psychological horror. 
[hr][/hr]

Livber Story Collection
Our exclusive short story series for the Livber email list continues. Story 3 is coming soon. We recently sent out a poll to decide its theme, and the results are split 50-50. There’s still time to cast your vote by checking your inbox.

[img src="data:image/png;base64,"]

You can sign up by sending us an email at community@inevgames.com  or by playing our demo and registering directly from within the game.



And if you’d like to help us even more, spread the word about our game to your friends, family, social media followers, or favorite streamers. Every bit of support means the world to us.



Thank you for being part of our journey!

notes.title: Big Demo Update – New Illustration, Animations, Soundtrack & More!
notes.notes:
Greetings from the dark streets of Livber,


We’re thrilled to unveil Demo v2, now live on Steam! Here’s what you’ll discover in this update:


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609737/9018891fc582702f86ecc5876b76f6abfc4e5fa7.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609737/1e44bf7728bdede1e1c2aa81018383af408db760.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609737/5f29d91d78c9c3ea15dd5d9d7fa9c2069205453a.jpg"][/carousel]
Full English Localization

  Every line of dialogue, menu and lore is now translated—immerse yourself without missing a single whisper.

Soundtrack Overhaul

  Lose yourself in brand-new tracks and remastered themes that bring Livber’s shadows to life.

Parallax Animations

  Watch backgrounds shift and swirl around you, adding cinematic depth to every scene.

Multiple Bug Fixes

  We’ve hunted down and eradicated dozens of issues for a smoother, more stable journey.

New Illustrations

  Feast your eyes on fresh artwork that expands our world’s haunting beauty.

Revamped Letter Mechanics

  Collect, decipher and unlock hidden messages with an all-new puzzle system



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609737/ec4e3d90136acef81335d7eb02107ab0ba0d79c4.jpg"]

Thank you for being part of our journey!  

Stay tuned for more updates...

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - 1
notes.notes:
New demo patch improves the game's performance and improves the game's story.



Bug Fixes:

- Very long texts are split into two, no need to scroll up for some long dialogs

- Fixed music not working when returning to main menu

- Fixed some typos

notes.title: Release Date Announced: June 23, 2025
notes.notes:
The release date of our game has been announced. Get ready on June 23rd, 2023. Our interactive psychological horror story with about 50.000 words and 4 different endings, "Livber: Smoke and Mirrors", will meet you soon.

Don't forget to add us to your wishlist to support us!
